name: @clawdhq/degen-db
description: Shared Prisma schema/client for the Degen autonomous-trading feature (risk config, custodied venue wallets, order/position ledger) — isolated from marketplace-db and social-db because it's the one schema that ever holds encrypted private key material

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsup && rm -rf dist/generated && cp -R src/generated dist/generated && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: echo "no unit tests — this package is schema + a generated client"
